description: Raw results from the confinement sweep in 05_confinement_study.ipynb. N=50 beads, 50000 Langevin dynamics steps per run, 8 replicates per condition, confinement_strength=50.0. Classical classifier (Alexander polynomial, provably-correct KMT simplification) is the trustworthy ground truth; TDA classifier (distance-matrix persistent homology) is confounded by confinement-induced compression - see notebook 5 section D for the full investigation.
conclusion: Within this simulation's accessible regime, genuine spontaneous knot formation essentially does not occur regardless of confinement strength, per the classical (trustworthy) classifier. The TDA classifier's apparent knotting transition (0/8 -> 8/8) is a confinement-compression artifact, root-caused in notebook 5: confined configurations robustly reduce to 4 vertices under KMT simplification (stable across 5 orders of magnitude of numerical tolerance), which is decisive proof of unknottedness since a 4-vertex polygon cannot represent any nontrivial knot.
